name: Google Cloud SQL
tagline: Google Cloud's managed MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server, with an Enterprise Plus tier for fast failover.
description: Cloud SQL is Google Cloud's managed service for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server. It automates provisioning, patching, backups, point-in-time recovery, high availability with a regional standby, and cross-region read replicas, and it connects to the rest of GCP through the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy, IAM database authentication and language connectors. The Enterprise Plus edition adds a data cache on local SSD, near-zero-downtime maintenance and faster failover. It covers most standard OLTP needs on Google Cloud; teams that need higher Postgres throughput or built-in analytics usually step up to AlloyDB, and those that need horizontal write scale go to Spanner.

pricing.notes: Billed per vCPU, memory and storage by edition (Enterprise, Enterprise Plus), with committed-use discounts; new Google Cloud accounts get trial credits and Cloud SQL offers time-limited free trial instances.

scale.notes: Vertical scaling with up to 64 TB storage; regional HA and cross-region read replicas for DR.

strengths: Stock MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server with simple operations
Enterprise Plus edition: local-SSD data cache and near-zero-downtime maintenance
IAM database authentication and Auth Proxy for secure connectivity
pgvector and MySQL vector support for AI features
Tight integration with GKE, Cloud Run and BigQuery federation
weaknesses: Extension allowlist and no superuser access
Throughput lags AlloyDB for demanding Postgres workloads
useCases: Standard web and mobile backends on Google Cloud
Migrating on-prem MySQL, Postgres or SQL Server to GCP
Cloud Run and GKE application databases
